barriers.sigma: sigma_before_touch (288 5m log returns ending at bar j-1, ddof=1)

T15.population: no barrier hit on j+1, j+2

b0.form: driftless BM in log price, two absorbing barriers, sine series
b0.discretisation: continuous monitoring (5m high/low are true intrabar extremes); no Broadie-Glasserman shift

B1.cells: family x STRUCT_SIDE per landmark (6 cells; '<=6' counts cells)

C1.base: champion M1-family spec (M1 if champion is B0)
C1.extra: OTHER_VENUE_MEDIAN_MOVE (#363), head B, T15 rows only, z-scored on training moments
C1.held_out: none; live shadow only from Day 0 on VPS live 1m Bybit/OKX closes; missing close -> forecast missing
C1.moments: training-fold; frozen: 2020-04..2024 T15 rows; files committed in docs/research_data/LEVEL_CROSS_VENUE_PERP_5M_V0
C1.limitation: dev on exchange 5m klines; live bars from trades (LiveBarBuilder)

ridge.objective: -loglik/n + (lambda/2)*||beta||^2, n = training rows of the head, intercepts unpenalised

held_out.source: data.binance.vision USD-M BTCUSDT 5m klines via beta.history_data.plan_objects
held_out.events: touch open >= 2025-01-01T00:00Z, 4h window closed before the freeze date (UTC midnight, exclusive)
held_out.event_exclusion: span (j-289 .. j+48) intersects the object gap; constructor drops incomplete source/active periods
held_out.parity_preflight: 2024 events from product 5m vs CORE 1m->5m, outcome-blind
held_out.published: prequential weekly calibrator, fitted only on events resolved before the week

calibrator.form: per head (R, B) logit p' = a + b logit p, Gaussian prior, MAP

level_effect_rule.claim_if: champion != B0 and held-out raw paired LL gain vs raw B0 95% interval > 0, per landmark
level_effect_rule.case_B: published = B0 with GENERIC intercept + shared slope (no level intercept); D3 absent; D1/D2 -> HIST
level_effect_rule.fallback_model: B0 with GENERIC intercept and shared slope only
level_effect_rule.level_intercepts: estimated in shadow and reported, never published in case B

L3_LIVE.plus: G2 and G3 on live published

gates_f3_planning.OFF: data fault, last closed bar older than 10 min at issue, parity break

FALLBACK.D2: last 100: CITL point outside +-10 pp and 95% interval excludes 0
FALLBACK.D3: case A only: last 100 paired LL_pub - LL_fallback 95% interval above 0
FALLBACK.in_fallback: D1/D2 on the fallback model; trigger -> HIST

gates_f3_planning.return: 50 new resolved since fallback; D2 band, restarted D1 <= 10, D3 not triggered

generic_race.anchors: close of every 5m bar closing on a UTC hour; rolling_sigma at the anchor

G1.replaces_GB0_if: pooled OOF LL lower by >= 0.002 nats

generic_race.dependence: week clusters; report anchors, pairs, weeks, anchors/4 as effective N
generic_race.calibration_link: per head shared slope b; intercepts per class GENERIC, LEVEL_T0, LEVEL_T15; a_level ~ N(a_GENERIC, 0.5^2) [F3]
generic_race.shared_slope: assumption; tested on held-out and live only

fallback_model: B0 with GENERIC intercept and shared slope; before first generic batch raw B0
window_end_display: close time of bar j+48, HH:MM UTC
reliability_line: stacked 5-bin table; bin of the largest displayed probability; ties P_UP, P_DN, neither; show bin N

band.edges_source: a priori numbers; not data terciles (T15 filter reads part of T0 outcome)

hist.key: landmark x family x STRUCT_SIDE (+ band at T15); orientation == STRUCT_SIDE on all 1919 dev events (F2)
hist.no_recompute: V1 table never recomputed after held-out or live; new table = V2
hist.templates_note: shares for barriers at the same distances; today's prices named separately; years in both lines
hist.scoring: per cell: shown h vs observed share per outcome with N; LL/Brier vs event B0; CITL; 5-bin

uncertainty.stat: h - b per cell and outcome

hist.time_display: user time zone via product formatter; no UTC in templates
hist.push_full_line: push carries N only; full LR_HIST_V1 with intervals one tap away (/levels)
hist.t15_display_rule: no T15 line if barrier hit or AMBIGUOUS on j+1/j+2
hist.ambiguous: excluded and counted at both landmarks

beta_changes: FORECAST_LAYER §6a: announced in advance, dated event in measurement contract, metrics before/after; §6-§7 rules frozen

amendment_after_development.g1_at_event: frozen G1 on the level event geometry (B0 offset, P_UP/P_DN, sigma, tau) + G1 intercepts + SIGMA_T (G1 edges); G1 head U as beyond|resolved
amendment_after_development.fallback_model: G1@event with GENERIC intercept and shared slope
amendment_after_development.publication_rule: Q6: case A only if raw champion beats raw B0 AND raw G1@event on held-out, week-clustered 95% interval > 0, per landmark; else case B
amendment_after_development.level_offset_claim: also raw champion vs raw G1@event held-out interval > 0, per landmark; never in user text
amendment_after_development.case_B_published: fallback model (G1@event + GENERIC intercept + shared slope) = calibrated B0 (Q5)
amendment_after_development.usual_model_states: raw G1@event; B0 kept in journal as second baseline; metrics vs both
amendment_after_development.fallback_templates: no separate «обычно» segment; numbers labelled as «обычно» (общая модель цены)
amendment_after_development.fallback_gate: published only if fallback passes G2 on the class; else HIST

freeze_candidate.case_B_rule: HIST or FALLBACK, never L3; sim: fallback passes G2 on level events in 0% of replications
